'''Tylan Londar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as an [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]]. Londar was based in the [[Imperial Data Processing Facility]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tazan]] and sometime after the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] of the planet [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], he encountered a team of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] agents that had [[Mission to Tazan|infiltrated]] the base.
